name: Town Square Las Vegas
summary: Open-air entertainment center with retail shops, restaurants & a movie theater.
demographics: Town Square Las Vegas attracts a diverse demographic mix including affluent local residents from Henderson and South Las Vegas suburbs, typically aged 25-54 with above-average household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center serves both Las Vegas locals seeking everyday shopping and dining options away from the tourist corridor, as well as domestic tourists staying at nearby hotels who prefer a more relaxed, family-oriented experience. Primary visitors include young professionals, families with children drawn to the entertainment venues and parks, and empty nesters who appreciate the upscale-casual dining and specialty retail options in an outdoor setting.
description: Town Square Las Vegas is a premiere one-of-a-kind retail, dining and entertainment destination located at 6605 Las Vegas Boulevard South. This open-air lifestyle center combines over 120 shops and restaurants with exceptional entertainment venues including an 18-screen AMC theater, Wiseguys Comedy Club, PopStroke golf entertainment, Stoney's Rockin' Country nightclub, and Velocity Esports gaming lounge. The center features beautifully landscaped outdoor spaces including Children's Park and Town Square Park, along with unique attractions like the Cactus Coaster and Dinosaur Outpost that create a family-friendly atmosphere. Designed with European-inspired architecture and tree-lined streets, Town Square offers a pedestrian-friendly shopping experience that stands apart from typical Las Vegas entertainment venues. With its diverse mix of national retailers, local boutiques, diverse dining options, and year-round events, Town Square has become a beloved gathering place for both Las Vegas residents and visitors seeking an alternative to the casino-centric Strip experience.
